build_flux2_text_encoder: build Flux2TextEncoderStep to generate text embeddings using Mistral3 for image generation guidance
build_flux2_klein_text_encoder: build Flux2KleinTextEncoderStep to generate text embeddings using Qwen3 for Flux2-Klein image generation
build_flux2_vae_encoder: build Flux2VaeEncoderStep to encode reference images into patchified latent representations for Flux2
build_flux2_remote_text_encoder: build Flux2RemoteTextEncoderStep to fetch text embeddings from a remote API endpoint for image generation
build_flux2_klein_base_text_encoder: build Flux2KleinBaseTextEncoderStep to generate positive and negative text embeddings using Qwen3 with classifier-free guidance
